name: Burning Blade Medallion
summary: Cultists in the Valley of Trials carry the Burning Blade Medallion. Yarrog Baneshadow holds it deep in the Burning Blade Coven, where its dark magic threatens Durotar's young warriors.

sections.title: A Mark of Corruption
sections.body: Zureetha Fargaze's divinations point to the medallion in the Burning Blade Coven. Yarrog Baneshadow, an agent of the Burning Blade cult, carries it deep inside the winding caverns. The trinket channels dark power among the cult's impish familiars and felstalkers. Defeating Yarrog and taking the medallion ends the cult's attempt to undermine the Horde's training grounds from within Durotar.

faq.q: What is the Burning Blade Medallion?
faq.answer: Yarrog Baneshadow, an operative of the Burning Blade cult hiding in Durotar, carries the magical talisman. It focuses dark magic and marks the bearer’s allegiance to the cult.

aliases: where do i turn in the medallion
faq.answer: Zureetha Fargaze, an orc seer outside the Den in the Valley of Trials, wants the medallion retrieved. She hopes to root out demonic influence and study the cult's local plans.
Yarrog Baneshadow holds the medallion deep inside the Burning Blade Coven, a hidden cave northwest of the Den in the Valley of Trials. He lurks along the cave's upper ledges.

faq.q: What does the medallion's presence mean for Durotar?
aliases: why are cultists in valley of trials
faq.answer: The medallion's presence confirms that the Burning Blade cult has placed operatives in the Horde's proving grounds. Its presence signals the cultists' broader, more dangerous ambitions across the orcish homeland.

angles.text: For an orc, the medallion recalls the demonic corruption that once enslaved your race. That shadow now threatens young initiates before they leave the Valley of Trials.
As a warlock of the Horde, you practice dark magic under strict discipline. The medallion marks the Burning Blade's rogue, unbound fel craft, which threatens Durotar's stability.
